overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: no April 9 minutes existed when requested the next morning, and the Board responded within 10 days. The March 13 allegation was already decided in OML 2014-73 and was not reviewed again.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to make its April 9 meeting minutes available to him upon his April 10 request.
allegations.key_passage: At that time, no minutes of this meeting existed.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to make its March 13 meeting minutes available upon request.
allegations.key_passage: In a prior decision, we addressed Mr. Saklad's allegations concerning the Board's minutes from the March 13 meeting.
